verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo is jammed against the top edge and sits right on the bottle cap. The body copy is tiny and hard to read at this size, and the bottle is pushed into the left corner, leaving a weak, sparse centre. B: the text is readable and the left-to-right order (logo, bottle, headline, CTA) is clear, but it is badly cramped. 'fizz' runs into the stacked decorative circles, the CTA and the three-line body copy nearly touch the bottom edge, and the bottle almost fills the full height.
